activities_budget.sourceTitle: Tickets Basic ticket Basic Ticket Barcelona - Museum | FC Barcelona
activities_budget.evidenceText: The official FC Barcelona ticket page identifies the Barça Immersive Tour in Barcelona and displays a General ticket at €31.00 plus €2.10 administration fees. Child and senior categories are also shown, but the adult label is not explicit; the date selector also shows From prices. Tax treatment is not stated.
activities_budget.referencePeriod: Official FC Barcelona result crawled 2 months before 2026-08-01; selected date Jun 26 2026 and tax treatment not stated
activities_budget.searchQuery: Barcelona Spain official attraction standard adult ticket price
activities_budget.reason: An official exact-city attraction and non-from General price were visible, but the source does not explicitly identify the General row as an adult ticket and does not state tax treatment. The strict adult-ticket definition therefore fails closed.

activities_mid_range.sourceTitle: CAMP NOU GUIDED TOUR | FC Barcelona Official Channel
activities_mid_range.evidenceText: The official Camp Nou Guided Tour has a group maximum of 6, duration 1 hour 30 mins, and a General ticket price of €45. The group basis and price are explicit, but duration is below the frozen 3–6-hour half-day window and tax treatment is not stated.
activities_mid_range.referencePeriod: Official FC Barcelona result crawled 5 days before 2026-08-01; page describes a 2018 tour date and tax treatment not stated
activities_mid_range.searchQuery: Barcelona Spain official half day group tour adult price duration
activities_mid_range.reason: The exact-city official group activity has a numeric General price but only 1.5 hours, which is outside the frozen half-day duration; adult labelling and tax treatment are also not fully compatible. No mid-range value is retained.

activities_high_end.sourceTitle: BARCELONA SHARED TOURS | Living Tours Group
activities_high_end.evidenceText: The named Barcelona operator's shared-tours brochure snippet lists a Montserrat & Penedés full-day tour with duration 10h and adult-price wording, but no numeric per-person price is exposed in the search evidence. Premium/private status and tax treatment are not stated.
activities_high_end.referencePeriod: Named-operator brochure published 1.1 years before 2026-08-01; pricing and tax treatment not stated in snippet
activities_high_end.searchQuery: Barcelona Spain official full day premium tour adult price duration
activities_high_end.reason: A named-operator 10-hour shared tour was visible, but no numeric non-from per-person adult price, explicit premium/private basis, or tax treatment was provided. The strict high-end definition fails closed.
